name: Arthur Géa
intro: Arthur Géa is a young player from a tiny village in France. He almost did not get into this tournament. Now he is one of its best stories.
story: Arthur lost in qualifying, the extra matches you play to get in. Then another player dropped out, so Arthur took his spot. That is called a lucky loser! He won a five-set match in round one, then won again. His whole village is cheering back home.

funFacts.text: His favorite band is the Red Hot Chili Peppers. His tennis idol is Rafael Nadal.
He played soccer first, like his dad. Then he switched to tennis at seven.
He says his heroes are his parents, Cécile and Christophe.
His hobby is taking ice baths. His favorite treat is pasta.
His favorite superhero is Iron Man. His favorite movie is Top Gun: Maverick.
He won his first big title in Los Cabos, Mexico, this summer. He beat Michael Zheng there!

watchFor: Watch his big forehand, his favorite shot, and count how often he smiles.

notes: Born 2 Jan 2005 in Carpentras, 180 cm, right-handed/two-handed backhand, Los Cabos 2026 title (final vs Shapovalov): en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arthur_Géa. Beat Michael Zheng en route in Los Cabos: atptour.com Los Cabos feature.
Grew up in Velleron, began tennis at 7, R1 win over J.M. Cerundolo, village gathers at a bar to watch: tennisactu.net. R1 score 3-6 6-2 6-3 3-6 1-6 (five sets) per tennis.com/Sofascore listings.
Lucky loser replacing Casper Ruud: atptour.com Ruud withdrawal article (tennistemple.com returned 403, source swapped).
Dad was a footballer and he started with football: ATP Los Cabos feature; started tennis at 7: ATP bio + tennisactu.
Heroes parents Cecile and Christophe, ice baths, pasta, Iron Man, Top Gun Maverick, favourite shot forehand, idol Nadal: atptour.com bio.
